# Card URL

## Summary
A card instance's identity is its URL: `<realm URL><path>` with no `.json`
extension. `resolveInstanceURL` is the canonical resolver from a possibly
relative reference to that absolute identity.

## Invariants
- The same path with `.json` addresses the source file; without it, the
  instance. Search results and links always use the extensionless form.
- Identity, not page position or file layout, decides card uniqueness —
  deduplicate by id.
- Relative references inside a realm resolve against the referencing
  document's location.

## Example
`https://realms-staging.stack.cards/richard.tan1/boxel-software-matrix-layer/Invoice/inv-2026-018`
is a card URL; the same URL plus `.json` addresses its source.

## Module
`https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` — export `resolveInstanceURL`;
addressing rules in `runtime-common`.
